description.narrative: The Support Programme for Ukraine project in Ukraine, implemented by the OSCE, aims to build the resilience of Ukrainian institutions and broader society in the face of Russia’s ongoing war of aggression. The objective of the grant is to support the implementation of projects managed by the programme. Key activities include capacity building for government agencies, emergency services, journalists and civil society organisations working for the protection of human rights, children’s psychosocial wellbeing, media freedom, and humanitarian demining, among others. The SPU has undertaken significant engagement with Ukrainian authorities on environmental issues, developing recommendations on mitigation and adaptation (also covering biodiversity) thereby contributing to the country’s Climate Adaptation Strategy and the development of the Environmental Recovery Strategy. It has also issued recommendations on water management, aiming to align Ukraine’s regulatory framework with EU standards.
